text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
A fierce, overwhelming performance. Though 
she fully demonstrated her strength, 
Duramente narrowly missed out on victory.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Yet her breathtaking run was undeniable, 
earning the recognition of even the 
Umamusume she had competed against.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
When she returned to the waiting room, the 
members of the family welcomed her. As she 
hung her head in shame over her poor 
showing, they gently reminded her that a 
racing career is long, and that she only 
needs to win the next one.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Before the gathered crowd, Duramente 
declared: Her next step was the world—to 
take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
